_comment: Copy to config.json on the boot media only. NEVER commit config.json. Initialize-WinPEAP.ps1 writes this for you.

_notes.Repo: owner/name of the repo (or your fork) the media pulls scripts from at runtime
_notes.Ref: branch or tag you pin to - e.g. 'main', or your own 'stable' / a version tag

GroupTagMenuExample.note: omit GroupTagMenu entirely for a plain 'Group Tag (blank = none)' prompt; include it for a numbered menu (a 'Manual entry' option is always appended)
